observations.observation: The isolated page numeral is read as 3.
The Roman VI has upper and lower horizontal strokes; both are retained.
A point is visible after un. The cancelled word after L is tentatively ou; cancellation prevents certainty.
The first word has clear c-e-l forms, but its final a is compressed or absent; cel|cela is retained.
The exact box clips the beginning of the word. The permitted whole-page image supplies the prefix of ensembliste; the crop directly shows its remaining letters and closing parenthesis.
The initial m of mulomb is lowercase.
The underlined second word reads pre...mières, with an overwritten or cancelled sign between pre and mières. Its underlying character is not securely readable.
The underline belongs to inclusion only.
No hyphen is visible between sous and figure; the definition label is transcribed without adding an accent.
The underline stops after At; the 0 is separate and slightly raised.
The marginal note was rotated clockwise 35 degrees for inspection. Its underline covers At, not the following 4.
The first binary sign is angled and the second is cup-shaped; the label is read as circled a.
The initial cancelled word is only tentatively Question. NB. is above it. The literal abbreviations tjrs and néc. are retained. The parentheses after Fig(L) are not read as a digit.
The left tilde spans the complete F-cap-G expression; the two right tildes are separate.
Inf begins with a capital I and its order symbol is raised. Circled b and both closing parentheses are retained.

The phrase ou Inf pour less-than-or-equal is inserted above the line. The parenthesis begins with an overbarred m, and the later phrase contains an actual equals sign. The number of final strokes in infinie(s), and the C-shaped final letter in F-vee-C, remain uncertain. The phrase reads le Inf without an added elision.

Exist is retained without expanding a final e. The last word is tentatively métrisé; its compressed middle remains doubtful. Neighboring circled labels are outside the marginal note's central inscription.
The product point is near the baseline. The second Inf argument has a small open c-shaped form, with no secure G tail, so c|G is retained.
Opening quotation marks are visible, but no closing marks are secure. No closing quotation marks have been supplied. Intersection and fine have separate underlines.
Underlying cancelled ink is too overlapped to read securely. Possible le-like strokes were insufficient for an asserted reading. A partial adjacent phi inscription is handled in B028.
The principal glyph is phi-shaped, with a long descending cross-stroke. The subscript is calligraphic F. The interior of the circled label is compressed; d is tentative.

Et is underlined. The last abbreviation in the upper line is clipped at the right box edge and remains tentative as élém with raised t; the permitted lower-half source was also inspected. The following line reads de calligraphic F (pour less-than-or-equal et pour much-less-than).
The box reads opening parenthesis followed by et.
